    What to do — manual steps (about 4 minutes)

    1. Create a public repository on GitHub.com

    1. Go to github.com/new
    2. Set:
      • Repository name: auriontick-privacy-policy
      • Visibility: Public
      • Add a README: ✅ Check this (initializes the repo so you can upload immediately)
    3. Click Create repository

    2. Upload the privacy policy

    1. On the new repo page, click Add file → Upload files
    2. Upload the file at artifacts/zen-tick/privacy-policy.html
    3. Rename it to index.html before committing — GitHub Pages serves the root file as index.html
    4. Commit directly to main

    3. Enable GitHub Pages

    1. Go to Settings → Pages (left sidebar)
    2. Under Source, select:
      • Branch: main
      • Folder: / (root)
    3. Click Save

    GitHub will display a banner: "Your site is ready to be published at…"

    4. Your URLs

    GitHub Pages takes 1–3 minutes to go live. Replace YOUR_USERNAME with your GitHub login:

    URL
    Repositoryhttps://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/auriontick-privacy-policy
    Privacy Policy (Pages)https://YOUR_USERNAME.github.io/auriontick-privacy-policy/

    You can verify HTTP 200 once it's live:

    curl -o /dev/null -s -w "%{http_code}" https://YOUR_USERNAME.github.io/auriontick-privacy-policy/
    # Should print: 200

    5. What to paste into Google Play Console

    In Play Console → Store listing → Privacy policy URL, paste:

    https://YOUR_USERNAME.github.io/auriontick-privacy-policy/
